summary: First-finish smoke testing on Venture Fund CRM. Backend auth + CRUD sanity confirmed via curl; frontend E2E via Playwright covering login (error + success), Overview metrics, fund switcher, create company, filter chips, company detail tabs (all 5), and logout. All critical checks passed.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with admin@fund.com/admin123 returns 200 and sets cookies
GET /api/funds returns seeded 'Beta Fund' and 'Fund I'
Login page: wrong password shows 'Invalid credentials' via [data-testid=login-error]
Dashboard shows metric-deployed, metric-dry-powder, metric-moic, metric-investments
fund-switcher dropdown lists 'Beta Fund' and 'Fund I'
Companies page: create via new-company-button + submit-company works; UITestCo appears in list
Logout via user-menu-trigger -> logout-menu-item redirects to /login
action_items: Minor a11y warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (non-blocking)
notes: Not exhaustively tested (deferred to full testing): register flow, new-conversation/diligence/investment/contact dialogs and their propagation to top-level /investments and /contacts, portfolio metric updates after investment, and ⌘K global search. Core auth + pipeline + navigation loop is green so main agent can proceed to first finish.
